card.line: Esek was a well in the valley of Gerar that Isaac's servants dug, and its name, meaning contention, recalls the quarrel over water there.

moments.title: A well worth fighting over
moments.text: Isaac's servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water. The herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac's herdsmen and said the water was theirs, so Isaac named the well Esek, because they contended with him.
